Summary

Strawberry Chair is now open for laps on Dell Valley! The gondola starts loading at 8:30 am, with Strawberry and the Mitey Mite carpet opening at 9:30 am. Enjoy early season turns and the rail park on lower Strawberry while our team works to open more lifts and runs as conditions allow. Save some energy for a few “laps” at Mad Trappers, open from 10:30 am. Visit our Early Season page for what’s open, operating hours and lift ticket prices.

Extended Forecast

Forecast updated: Sunday, November 15th, 2026 5:00 AM

Summary

One system will be moving late this afternoon and lasting through Monday morning, bringing mainly cloudy skies and very light flurries. The sun reappears from Tuesday on with a benign and generally seasonable pattern for the rest of the week. Lows Tuesday night through Thursday night will be near -10 C in the alpine with cold low-level temperatures and mainly clear skies.
